title: Lab: FizzBuzz
description: FizzBuzz is a classic test of loops and conditions, and a favourite in job interviews. Now it is yours.
instructions:
Print the numbers from 1 to 30, one per line, except:

  • for multiples of 3, print Fizz instead of the number,
  • for multiples of 5, print Buzz,
  • for multiples of both 3 and 5, print FizzBuzz.
tests: The first five lines should be 1, 2, Fizz, 4, Buzz.
The last line should be FizzBuzz (for 30), and there should be exactly 30 lines.
hints: Check "both" first. Otherwise a multiple of 15 is caught by the "multiple of 3" branch.
n % 3 == 0 is true when n divides by 3 exactly.
